landing.metaDescription: Write a B2-level German essay and get instant, AI-graded feedback against the Goethe exam rubric — no account needed to see your score.
landing.title: Practice a B2-style essay
landing.description: Pick a prompt or write freely, get an instant score against the Goethe B2 rubric with specific errors marked — no account needed to see how you did.
landing.fastFeedbackBody: Your score and one worked example, usually within a minute.
landing.noInstallBody: Works right in your phone or desktop browser.

write.metaDescription: Write or paste your B2-level German essay — no account needed to submit it.
write.title: Write your essay
write.description: Type or paste your German-language essay below, then submit it. No account needed.
write.placeholder: Write or paste your essay here...
write.recommendedRangeGuidance: 150–200 words is the recommended length for a B2 essay.
write.lengthWarning: That's longer than the recommended range, but you can still submit it.
write.tooShortError: Your essay is too short to grade — write at least 50 words.
write.tooLongError: Your essay is too long — keep it to 300 words or fewer.
write.successBody: Your essay has been submitted. Taking you to your result...
write.errorGeneric: Something went wrong submitting your essay. Please try again.
write.rateLimitedError: You've reached the submission limit for now — please wait a bit before submitting another essay.

preview.metaDescription: Your overall score and a worked example from your own essay.
preview.title: Your essay result
preview.description: Here is how your essay did against the Goethe B2 rubric.
preview.pendingBody: Your essay was received and is being graded. This page updates by itself when your score is ready — there's no need to refresh.
preview.completeAnnouncement: Grading finished. Your overall score is
preview.exampleTitle: A worked example from your essay
preview.exampleIntro: This is a sentence you wrote, with one mistake marked and explained.
preview.noExample: We couldn't pinpoint a specific sentence to show as an example for this essay.
preview.flaggedBody: Part of your essay looked like an instruction to the grader rather than an answer to the task, so we haven't given it a score — a score from that essay wouldn't be a fair assessment. This check can be wrong. If you think it is, reword that part and submit your essay again.
preview.failedBody: No score was produced, and we haven't guessed one. You can submit your essay again.

failedReasons.wordCountOutOfBounds: Your essay wasn't between 50 and 300 words when we went to grade it.
failedReasons.providerError: The grading service didn't respond properly.
failedReasons.invalidProviderResponse: The grading service gave an answer we couldn't use.
failedReasons.essayMissing: We couldn't find your essay any more.

preview.pollErrorTitle: We couldn't check on your grade
preview.pollErrorBody: We lost contact with the server, so we can't tell whether your essay has been graded yet. Check your connection and try again.
preview.pollErrorNotFoundBody: We couldn't find a grade for this essay. You can submit it again.
